summary: Elong Power Holding Ltd., a Beijing-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a November 5, 2026 inducement offer letter with holders of three tranches of Class A ordinary share purchase warrants (May, July and August 2026 issuances, all struck at $3.80). Holders agreed to partially exercise warrants for 1,808,803 shares; the company agreed to cut the exercise price on all existing warrants to $1.80 and issue 2,713,204 new warrants (150% coverage) at $2.50, expiring in three years, privately under Section 4(a)(2). No board recommendation or advisor named; the structure carries full-ratchet and VWAP reset anti-dilution. Watch dilution overhang and potential further repricing.
